title: Nexus CoreWorkflowEventBatch
description: One bounded pull from a workflow event subscription: at most 16 frames and 1 MiB, already encoded, in ring order. Frames keep the existing run-event vocabulary (`run_state`, `host_event`, `gap`, `history_unavailable`) and the existing `<UUID epoch>:<decimal sequence>` cursor; the transport writes `id`/`event`/`data` verbatim and never resequences.

events.description: Frames strictly after the subscription's current cursor, in ring order.

id.description: SSE cursor `<UUID epoch>:<decimal sequence>`, or the empty string for a control frame that carries no cursor (a history_unavailable close).

event.description: Event name discriminated from the frame payload.

data.description: Frame payload, already serialized by the core; the transport must not re-encode it.

closed.description: True when the stream ended AT this batch: the run reached its durable terminal frame, the ring is gone, or the subscription was released or the owner closed. No further pull is served for a closed subscription.
